title: TLS config loading duplicated identically in smtp and mail crates
description: smtp/src/tls.rs and mail/src/tls.rs contain nearly identical load_tls_config() implementations. When the TLS loading logic needs updating (rustls version bump, certificate format change, SNI handling), the change must be made in two places. Rewrite: extract to a usenet-ipfs-tls utility crate or to a module in usenet-ipfs-core.
